description: This file contains an abstract test runner class for testing resource selector implementations within the Orleans streaming subsystem. It includes various internal test methods to verify resource selection behavior, such as coverage of all resources, non-infinite looping, and avoiding re-selection of excluded resources.

classes.name: ResourceSelectorTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing testing methods for resource selector implementations, ensuring proper resource distribution and exclusion handling.

methods.name: NextSelectionWillGoThroughEveryResourceIfExistingSelectionEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that the resource selector can iterate over all resources when no prior selection exists.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontGoInfinitely
methods.description: Ensures that the resource selector does not get stuck in an infinite loop when selecting resources with a large max value.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelections
methods.description: Checks that the resource selector does not re-select resources that are already excluded.
